This is a genuine codegen contract test, not a stub.

AT-1731/AT-1732 are real GPU dispatch tests with non-symmetric integer-f16 fixtures (M=N=64, K=32 and K=48). max_diff==0.0 assertion is non-negotiable and carries an explicit HONESTY GATE comment forbidding tolerance relaxation. Typed-skip on Lavapipe CoopMatUnsupported is correct behavior. Both confirmed bit-exact by QA on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000.

The 768³ 25%/6× win is correctly labeled competitive (equals the threshold exactly).
Zero codegen change confirmed: git diff main..HEAD -- crates/axc-codegen/src/ is empty. The N-phi single-loop path was already general; AT-1733 locked it without touching implementation.

matmul_rb_coopmat.axc kernel is well-constructed: asymmetric index recovery (gid(0)/32 for col, gid(1) unchanged for row, IDENTICAL idiom to M3.3b), 4 accumulators declared before K-loop, all unconditionally reassigned at the top level (AT-1708 compliant), A and B shared tiles each loaded once and reused across 4 mul_adds (the arithmetic intensity gain), correct c_base offsets for all 4 output tiles, explicit return (anti-pattern #2), no >> operator (anti-pattern #8).
AT-1734 CI compile anchor verifies matmul_rb_coopmat.axc compiles clean + spirv-val + shared_memory_bytes==2048 without any GPU — solid CI gate.

minor_issues.description: The iter_custom closure re-invokes resident_min_of_n at 256³ a second time for criterion duration bookkeeping (after already calling measure_rb_tflops for 256³/512³/768³). This means each criterion iteration runs ~4 full min-of-N measurement passes. This is non-blocking (bench is behind AXC_ENABLE_GPU_BENCHES gate, not a correctness issue, and the structure matches the existing AT-1710 bench pattern), but is slightly wasteful. Consider refactoring to cache the 256³ timing from the first measure_rb_tflops call if criterion bookkeeping ever becomes sensitive.

strip_strategy_annotation_block matches the first occurrence of '@strategy' in the source string; if '@strategy' appears in comments before the annotation, the wrong position is found. This is a pre-existing bug (present on main), not introduced by M3.3c. The workaround (avoiding '@strategy' in .axc comments) is applied in matmul_rb_coopmat.axc and is safe. Recommend filing a standalone fix (replace simple string find with a regex that requires '@strategy' to be followed by optional whitespace + '{').

In the AT-1733 inline kernel, acc_10 and acc_11 are stored to the SAME c_base (0 and 16 respectively) as acc_00 and acc_01. This means the AT-1733 test stores all 4 accumulators to overlapping addresses. This is intentional for the codegen pre-gate (the test only checks phi shape, not numeric correctness — there are no CPU reference checks), and the comment explains AT-1733 is a 'pre-gate' not a dispatch test. The real correctness check is AT-1731/1732. No action required.
